# Support

## Using Skotiq

1. Start with the **[user documentation](../docs/index.md)** (install → first connection → first image).
2. Check **[known limitations](../docs/known-limitations.md)** and **[troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting/common-issues.md)** for your platform.
3. For remote imaging, follow **[headless secure setup](../docs/headless-secure-setup.md)** before exposing services on your LAN.

## Getting help

| Need | Where |
|------|--------|
| Questions and imaging workflows | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/Skotiq/discussions) |
| Bug or regression | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/Skotiq/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Feature idea | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/Skotiq/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Security concern | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — private report only |
| Releases & upgrades | [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/Skotiq/releases) and [CHANGELOG.md](../docs/CHANGELOG.md) |

Include **Skotiq version**, **OS**, **driver backend** (ASCOM / Alpaca / INDI / native), and **equipment models** when reporting hardware issues.

## Contributing code

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, CI gates, and conventions.

## Supporting the project

Skotiq is independently developed by Sean Douglas. All features are free to use;
[Patreon support](https://www.patreon.com/c/SeanDouglas) is entirely optional.
Support helps fund development, hardware testing and compatibility work. Membership
details are maintained on Patreon. Financial support does not imply a guaranteed
response time or support contract.

For public reports, remove access tokens, passwords and private location information
from logs before posting. Use the private security-reporting route for vulnerabilities.
